## State and behavior contract

Controlled/uncontrolled (`open`/`onOpenChange`/`defaultOpen`) non-modal menu; `DropdownMenuItem`'s `onSelect` closes the menu by default after the handler runs, `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem` stays open by default, and `DropdownMenuRadioGroup` fails safe by disabling every item that shares a duplicate value.

## Provider and dependencies

- `BeeUIProvider` is required above this family because it participates in shared overlay/toast runtime infrastructure.
- **Peer/native dependencies visible to this Registry item:** `react`, `react-native`
- **Registry dependency closure:** `button`, `core-overlay`, `overlay-runtime`, `text`, `theme`, `use-direction`
- Safe-area ownership remains explicit: shell surfaces touching system edges opt into `SafeArea`; components do not silently invent app-shell insets.
- Web consumers load the BeeUI semantic theme CSS as documented in [Web onboarding](/docs/start/web/).
